guidance.blur: Hold the camera steady and refocus on the subject.
guidance.label_obstructed: Uncover the identification label and retake so the text is fully visible.
guidance.underexposed: Add even lighting and retake without deep shadows.
guidance.framing: Part of the device is cut off. Step back so the whole device is in the frame.
guidance.glare_or_overexposed: Move the light or change the camera angle to reduce glare.
guidance.needs_review: Ask a human to review the intended view and visible detail.

reasons.blur: Focus or motion blur obscures relevant detail
reasons.label_obstructed: Part of the identification label is covered or unreadable
reasons.underexposed: The required subject is too dark to inspect reliably
reasons.framing: Part of the intended subject or label lies outside the frame
reasons.glare_or_overexposed: Excessive brightness or glare reduces visible subject detail
reasons.needs_review: The intended view or visible detail is uncertain
